name: My Husband Is A Big Shot
original_name: My Husband Is A Big Shot
overview:
She marries a driver impulsively after being cuckolded. Does she know who he is?

On her wedding day, Selena Lane is betrayed by her fiancé and her half-sister. In a desperate bid to escape her family, Selena impulsively marries a passing driver named Robert. However, Robert is not who he seems; he is actually the CEO of Accord Group. He tries to keep his identity a secret, yet his brother eventually find out where he is…
